The brochure includes historical non-pool and 2 BR duplex variants beyond the current four-category FAQ. Only pages 63 and 65 visibly print brochure NET areas. Other brochure areas remain unavailable. Unit areas retain the mirror’s printed NET AREA definition, subject to approved contractual confirmation. All original sheets and watermarks remain intact.

review.imagery: Twenty-five own-source gallery renders cover the building complex, leisure deck, roof, shared spaces and home interiors. All 45 native brochure resources and six primary gallery images were visually reviewed. Repeated layers, isolated decorative resources, generic car imagery and room-render moodboards are excluded from drawing choices. The current developer’s complete-complex view supplies the card and hero. Paired buildings and shared facilities retain Waves-complex context. No Phase I-only image or exact-unit view is asserted.
review.floorPlans: Eight complete official brochure drawings and 138 unit-specific sheets from the Homeland broker mirror. The brochure includes historical non-pool and 2 BR duplex variants beyond the current four-category FAQ. Only pages 63 and 65 visibly print brochure NET areas. Other brochure areas remain unavailable. Unit areas retain the mirror’s printed NET AREA definition, subject to approved contractual confirmation. Units 203, 206, 504, 702 and 1110 have conflicting written floor labels versus their key plans. Options use unit numbers without endorsing a floor. The mirror visibly prints 1,355.5 for unit 105 and 656.6 for unit 107, while Tanami lists 1,355.05 and 656.06 respectively. These conflicts require developer confirmation. All original sheets and watermarks remain intact. Complete brochure pages 52–66 were visually reviewed. Six hidden area strings were rejected because no visible area panel supports them. All 138 complete mirror images and their 138 identity/NET panels were reviewed. Ten partial OCR readings were manually transcribed from visible panels and stored in the review ledger. Unit 707 retains its visibly printed 719.57 sq ft. No repeated-layout area is substituted. Five floor-label conflicts are explicitly disclosed. Goldpillars lists additional floorplates and Tanami lists extra upper-floor homes. Their Node fetches returned HTTP 403. Aumra’s public project HTML identified an additional Reelly PDF, but its download was rejected by automatic approval review with only the reason blocked by policy. That PDF remains unavailable and uninspected. It is excluded from the delivered source pack.
review.location: Both complete brochure maps 35–36 were reviewed. The JVC neighbourhood map is displayed intact. Fourteen current-primary time ranges are source-qualified. The official name-only map query is recorded with HTML hash. No numerical pin or visitor-entrance coordinate is inferred.
review.provenance: Official primary HTML, original brochure PDF, native image origins, broker index receipt and all 138 original mirror image hashes are retained. Each brochure sheet links to its physical PDF page. Each broker image links to its actual source image. Full original watermarks, branding and sheet content are preserved. Completed text research and protected identity remain intact.

unavailable: Six brochure drawings have no visible numerical area panel. Additional listed upper-floor/unit drawings and building floorplates were not verified because the supplementary sources were inaccessible or their download was blocked. Conflicting floor labels and portal areas, variant applicability, approved contractual NET-area definitions, exact visitor entrance, unit-specific finish/view, live travel times and dated construction photographs require confirmation.
